result:
Looking at the qlang documentation, I need to write queries for data transformation tasks. Let me work through each one, building from the examples provided.

Key concepts I'm using:
- `filter ~(...)` to filter arrays
- `* expr` to map over elements
- `groupBy` to group by a key
- `at` for soft reading (returns null if missing)
- `if` for conditionals
- `sort ~(...)` for sorting with modifiers
- `|` to pipe results through commands

T1: Count active users with non-null email ending "@example.com" (case-insensitive)
T2: Get users with "admin" role (any case) and their names sorted by lowercase
T3: Count users per country (missing → "unknown")
T4: Average age of users with non-null age, rounded to 2 decimals
T5: From open issues, collect lowercase unique label names, sorted
T6: Top 3 issues by comments desc, ties broken by number asc
T7: Count open issues per assignee (exclude null/missing)
T8: Merge dependencies, filter "^" versions, return "name@version" sorted
T9: Services with enabled=true (missing=false) and port>8000, names lowercased sorted, comma-joined
T10: Count ERROR lines per service (3rd token)
T11: Average of ms=<int> values from lines containing them, rounded to 1 decimal
T12: Revenue from "shipped" orders (any case), skip empty prices, rounded to 2 decimals
T13: Top 2 customers by total spend (exclude "cancelled" and empty prices)
T14: Word list: lowercase, dedupe, sort by length desc then alphabetically, dash-joined

T1: /data/users | filter ~(if /active (if (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") false) false) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | * /name | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | * (at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count
T4: /data/users | filter ~(at /profile/age | ne null) | * (at /profile/age) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at /assignee | if (ne null) (/login) null)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at /assignee | if (ne null) (/login) null) | filter (ne null) | groupBy * count
T8: (/dependencies | union /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * ([((/0 | print) /1)] | join "@") | sort
T9: /services | filter ~(if (at /enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000) false) | * /name | * lower | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~((split " " | at 1) | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | at 2 | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first | if (ne null) (drop 3 | parseJson) null) | filter (ne null) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~((/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | if true (/4 | ne "") false) | * (((/3 | parseJson) * (/4 | parseJson))) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(:r / | if (r | /5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (r | /4 | ne "") false) | * {:customer /1 :total ((/3 | parseJson) * (/4 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/customer) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | sum ~(/total) | round 2)} | sort ~(desc /total) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
